textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Chanda Mama Counts the Stars · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Chanda Mama is the Moon. Sometimes he looks round like a circle and sometimes he looks different.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Chanda Mama is the Moon. Sometimes he looks round like a circle and sometimes he looks different. One night he started counting the stars, one, two, three, ten, twenty-one, forty-five, ninety-nine, and so on.
beats.speakEn: Chanda Mama is the Moon. Sometimes he looks round like a circle and sometimes he looks different. One night he started counting the stars, one, two, three, ten, twenty-one, forty-five, ninety-nine, and so on.

beats.en: One night Chanda Mama was so upset that he began to cry. The Sun saw his tears and told him not to worry. The Sun said that the number of lovely children is the same as the number of stars in the sky.
beats.speakEn: One night Chanda Mama was so upset that he began to cry. The Sun saw his tears and told him not to worry. The Sun said that the number of lovely children is the same as the number of stars in the sky.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Chanda Mama Counts the Stars · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Round means shaped like a circle. To count is to say numbers one by one to find how many. Tears are drops of water that come from the eyes when we cry.
